leave.title: Leave the game?
leave.body: Your seat stays open for someone else to take over.

lobby.playersHint: Everyone cooperates: cure the four diseases before they overrun the world.

difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.hint_one: {{count}} epidemic card in the player deck.
difficulty.hint_other: {{count}} epidemic cards in the player deck.

roleMode.title: Roles
roleMode.randomHint: Each player is dealt a role at random.
roleMode.chooseHint: Before the game, each player picks a role nobody else has.

preflight.title: Before the game
preflight.pickHint: Pick a role nobody else has. You can change it until you confirm.
preflight.locked: You have confirmed. Undo to change your role.

board.won: You cured all four diseases. You win!

contingency-planner.name: Contingency Planner
contingency-planner.power: As an action, take an Event card from the player discard pile and keep it on this card. Play it as usual; it then leaves the game. It does not count toward the hand limit.

dispatcher.name: Dispatcher
dispatcher.power: Move another player's pawn as if it were yours, if its owner agrees. Or move any pawn to a city with another pawn, for one action.

medic.name: Medic
medic.power: Treat Disease removes all cubes of one color. A cured disease's cubes are removed from your city at once, and none can be placed there.

operations-expert.name: Operations Expert
operations-expert.power: Build a research station without discarding a card. Once a turn, from a station, discard any City card to move to any city.

quarantine-specialist.name: Quarantine Specialist
quarantine-specialist.power: No disease cubes are placed in your city or the cities connected to it, and no outbreaks happen there.

researcher.name: Researcher
researcher.power: On your turn, give any City card from your hand to a player in your city. Another player can still only take the card of the city you share.

scientist.name: Scientist
scientist.power: Discover a cure with only 4 City cards of one color.

teacher.name: Teacher
teacher.power: As an action, create a student pawn in your city (at most 2 per game). At the start of your turn, choose the teacher or a student: that pawn does this turn's actions, with your hand.

relocation-specialist.name: Relocation Specialist
relocation-specialist.power: Whenever your pawn leaves a city, however it moves, you may take up to 3 disease cubes and/or 1 other pawn (if its owner agrees) from that city to where you arrive.

crisis-mitigator.name: Crisis Mitigator
crisis-mitigator.power: Your actions each turn depend on the disease cubes in your city when your turn starts: 0–1 cubes: 4 actions, 2: 5, 3: 6, 4 or more: 7.

generalist.name: Generalist
generalist.power: You have 5 actions each turn instead of 4.

z-force-team-member.name: Z-Force Team Member
z-force-team-member.power: Start in Montreal. As an action, move to Montreal or Essen. When you discover a cure, other players in your city may give up to 2 of its cards (if they agree).

carry.title: Take along
carry.hintMove: Choose the cubes and the pawn that come with you, then where to go on the map.
carry.hintAccept: Choose the cubes and the pawn that come with you, then accept.

eventInfo.airlift: Move any 1 pawn to any city. Get permission before moving another player's pawn.
eventInfo.forecast: Look at the top 6 cards of the infection deck, then put them back in any order.
eventInfo.government-grant: Build a research station in any city, with no card to discard.
eventInfo.one-quiet-night: Skip the next Infect Cities step: no infection card is flipped.
eventInfo.resilient-population: Remove any 1 card in the infection discard pile from the game. It can also be played between an epidemic's Infect and Intensify steps.

actions.title: Actions
actions.choosePawn: Choose the pawn for this turn

share.title: Share Knowledge
share.offered: {{from}} offers to share the card of {{city}} with {{to}}.

forecast.title: Forecast
forecast.hint: Drag the cards (or use the arrows) into the order they will be flipped, then keep it.
forecast.waiting_one: {{name}} is arranging the top infection card.
forecast.waiting_other: {{name}} is arranging the top {{count}} infection cards.

errors.wrong-step: Not now: finish the current step first.
errors.not-adjacent: That city is not next to yours.
errors.card-missing: You do not have that card.
errors.station-exists: There is a research station here already.
errors.no-cubes: There are no cubes of that color here.
errors.bad-cards: These cards do not make a cure.
errors.card-resolving: Not now: a card is being resolved.
errors.not-playable: This event cannot be played like that.
errors.bad-order: Put back exactly the cards you took.
errors.bad-partner: You cannot share with that player.
errors.not-together: You must be in the same city.
errors.no-offer: There is no offer to answer.
errors.not-your-answer: It is not your answer to give.
errors.roles-dealt: The roles are dealt at random in this game.
errors.cannot-restart: The turn cannot be restarted now.
errors.choose-pawn-first: Choose the pawn for this turn first.
errors.pawn-chosen: The pawn for this turn is chosen already.
errors.teacher-pawn-only: Only the teacher pawn can create a student.

step.increase: the infection rate marker moves forward.
step.infect: the bottom infection card gets 3 cubes.
step.intensify: the infection discard pile is shuffled back on top of the deck.

eventBar.airliftPawn: Airlift: choose the pawn to move.
eventBar.airliftCity: Airlift {{name}}: tap the city to move to.
eventBar.grantCity: Government Grant: tap the city for the new station.
eventBar.grantMove: Government Grant in {{city}}: choose the station to take away.
eventBar.population: Resilient Population: choose the card to remove from the game.
